text.en: Dog owners consistently commend manager Seb and the daycare crew for their helpful and flexible approach. Clients note that the team take the time to understand each dog's individual temperament, treating every visiting pet like a valued member of the family.

Reviews highlight the exceptional care given to dogs ranging from young seven-month-old puppies to energetic adult companions. Owners appreciate that pets are supervised closely during group play, allowing them to form dog friendships in a safe and supportive setting.

Clients report complete peace of mind knowing their dogs spend the day running freely in open fields. Reviewers note that their dogs return home happy, healthy, and pleasantly tired after hours of active outdoor stimulation and companionship in Barnaslingan.

q.en: Where is the daycare facility located?

a.en: The centre is based at Silverpines on Barnaslingan Lane in South County Dublin, offering scenic outdoor fields.

q.en: Can young puppies attend the daycare?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm enrolling puppies as young as seven months old for daytime socialization and play.

q.en: What outdoor activities do dogs participate in?

a.en: Dogs enjoy structured exercise running around in open green paddocks alongside supervised canine companions.

q.en: How do dogs feel upon returning home?

a.en: Owners frequently report that their pets return home content, calm, and happily tired after active play.
